MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable SSD feels useful for backing up and moving files between computers, fitting my pattern of buying practical computer accessories.",
    "The over-ear headphones connect to my previous headsets and under-desk headphone mount, making quieter desk listening a plausible next step.",
    "The SanDisk card connects to my earlier memory card and Raspberry Pi purchases, though I would check compatibility before choosing it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming devices, smart display, and security cameras serve needs I have not shown; my recent purchases are mostly about equipping and maintaining my computer setup.",
    "Earbuds do not match the desk-listening use that makes the over-ear headphones appealing, and my history gives me no particular reason to choose Apple earbuds.",
    "The enterprise hard drive shares a storage purpose with the SSD, but I have not shown a need for 16TB or equipment to connect an internal drive."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics seems to have been taken as interest in connected devices broadly, even when they would not help with my current projects.",
    "My audio purchases seem to have been treated as interest in any headphones, overlooking how and where I would use them.",
    "My NES-inspired Raspberry Pi case does not by itself make a themed streaming bundle useful to me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My cables, Ethernet adapter, cable organizers, and computer duster point toward practical setup improvements and maintenance.",
    "The intended device matters: a card for my Garmin does not establish that a larger card will work there, and Raspberry Pi storage also needs a compatibility check.",
    "Storage capacity and connection requirements matter to me; portable file storage is a more plausible need than an enterprise drive requiring additional equipment."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my computer, storage, and desk-audio interests but stretched them into unrelated connected devices and poorly matched equipment."
}
